title: Member-Requested Extension of Prior Authorization Review Time
content:
Under Prior Authorization, a member may ask Prairie Ridge Health Plan for more time before an undecided request is decided.

## Member handbook terms

**Term 1: the member's request for more review time.** A member whose transition-of-care request is waiting for the prior plan's papers may ask Prairie Ridge to take more time to decide it; the member makes that request in person and it is recorded as a deadline extension asked for by the member, with written notice of the extension of review time mailed the same day, and the decision deadline may be extended this way once.

**Term 2: when the days are fixed.** The days a member-requested deadline extension adds are not fixed until a transition-of-care request for the member stands on file undecided.

Term 2 in other words: as long as the member has no transition-of-care request on file that is still undecided, the days such an extension adds are not yet fixed.

| Point | Term |
|---|---|
| Who asks | the member, in person |
| How it is recorded | as a deadline extension asked for by the member |
| Notice | written notice of the extension of review time, mailed the same day |
| How often | the decision deadline may be extended this way once |

## Tool reference: `request_review_time_extension_2522d00e`

### Situation of use and capability
The tool is the member's own request that Prairie Ridge take more time to decide one of the member's undecided Prior Authorization requests. One call records, dated today, a deadline extension asked for by the member that adds the given number of calendar days to the decision deadline of that request, together with the written notice of the extension of review time mailed to the member the same day. The member then sees the extension and the mailed notice on the request's history.

### How it is invoked
`request_review_time_extension_2522d00e` belongs to the member: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

### Parameters
- `authorization_id`: the reference number of the member's undecided prior authorization request whose decision deadline is being extended, as the agent reads it to the member from the prior authorization records (an identifier).
- `extension_days`: the number of calendar days added to the decision deadline, written as whole integer days.

### Return
A confirmation sentence stating the deadline-extension entry reference (an identifier beginning with "aac_"), the notice entry reference (also beginning with "aac_"), the request reference, the whole number of days added, and the date recorded and mailed (YYYY-MM-DD, today). The presence of both references shows that the extension was recorded. The tool defines no other return.
